sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Do not freeze: preserve the ship target, shipIceStrengthened=true applicability gate with missing-selector violation, inclusive fore/aft bounds, ship ownership, decimal QuantityValue operands, and metre units. The candidate still encodes iceClass and the upper/lower ice-waterline relationships as presence-only nodes; neither SHACL nor the SPARQL query links those nodes to the corresponding minimum/maximum fore/aft draught bounds or verifies that the bounds are determined in accordance with the same ice class and waterlines.
